Sulphuric acid is used in fertilizers, petroleum refining, and detergents, while soda ash is utilized in glass manufacturing, chemicals, detergents, and other industrial sectors. The diverse applications ensure their demand in various regions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The reason (R) accurately explains the assertion (A) because the widespread industrial demand for these chemicals drives their production across multiple regions in India. This makes the production of inorganic chemicals decentralized rather than confined to a single area.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Hence, the correct answer is: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Inorganic Chemical Industry in India:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The inorganic chemical industry plays a critical role in India's economy as it supports key sectors like agriculture, textiles, glass, and paper.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Prominent inorganic chemicals produced in India include sulphuric acid, soda ash, caustic soda, and ammonia.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Production centers are located across states such as Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh, ensuring decentralized operations due to the location of end-use industries.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Sulphuric Acid:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Sulphuric acid is one of the most widely used industrial chemicals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Applications: Fertilizer manufacturing (e.g., phosphates), petroleum refining, wastewater processing, and chemical synthesis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • India is a significant producer of sulphuric acid, with plants located near industrial hubs to cater to local demand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Soda Ash:The correct answer is Only 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Delegated legislation refers to the process whereby legislative powers are delegated by the legislature to the executive or another subordinate authority. The legislature enacts a parent or enabling act, and under this act, the executive frames detailed rules, regulations, or orders to operationalize the law. Hence, statement 1 is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • However, delegated legislation is not immune from judicial review. Courts have the authority to examine such legislation to ensure that it does not exceed the powers conferred by the enabling act or violate constitutional provisions. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The judiciary, through the doctrine of ultra vires, can strike down delegated legislation if it exceeds the limits of the powers granted by the legislature or if it is inconsistent with the parent act or the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Delegated Legislation:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It is also known as subordinate or secondary legislation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It is framed by bodies like the executive (government departments, ministries, or statutory authorities) under powers delegated by the legislature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Examples: Rules and regulations framed by ministries under acts like the Factories Act, 1948, or the Environmental Protection Act, 1986.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The parent act or enabling act specifies the framework, objectives, and boundaries within which delegated legislation must operate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Judicial Review of Delegated Legislation:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Courts have the power to review delegated legislation to ensure that it does not exceed the authority conferred by the parent act (ultra vires).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Delegated legislation can be challenged on grounds such as:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Substantive Ultra Vires: When the legislation exceeds the powers granted by the enabling act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Procedural Ultra Vires: When the procedural requirements laid down by the enabling act are not followed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Violation of Fundamental Rights: If the delegated legislation contravenes provisions of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Examples: In the case of In Re Delhi Laws Act (1951), the court upheld the validity of delegated legislation but emphasized that it must conform to the Constitution and the enabling act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Importance of Delegated Legislation:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It helps in addressing the technical and dynamic aspects of governance, which the legislature may not be equipped to handle in detail.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ensures flexibility and adaptability in the implementation of laws.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Reduces legislative workload by allowing the executive to frame detailed rules and regulations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Advantages of Delegated Legislation:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Enables technical experts to frame detailed rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Facilitates faster law-making, especially in emergencies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ensures flexibility in responding to changing circumstances.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Limitations of Delegated Legislation:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • May lead to excessive delegation, undermining the authority of the legislature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Risk of misuse by the executive, leading to arbitrary or unconstitutional rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Over-reliance on delegated legislation can dilute parliamentary control.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Judicial Safeguards:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The judiciary ensures that delegated legislation adheres to the principles of the rule of law and remains within the ambit of the parent act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The courts act as a check against arbitrary or excessive use of delegated powers by the executive.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    सही उत्तर केवल 1 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • प्रत्यायोजित विधान उस प्रक्रिया को संदर्भित करता है जिसके द्वारा विधायी शक्तियों को विधायिका द्वारा कार्यकारी या किसी अन्य अधीनस्थ प्राधिकरण को प्रत्यायोजित किया जाता है। विधायिका एक मूल या सक्षम अधिनियम बनाती है, और इस अधिनियम के तहत, कार्यकारी कानून को संचालित करने के लिए विस्तृत नियम, विनियम या आदेश तैयार करता है। इसलिए, कथन 1 सही है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • हालांकि, प्रत्यायोजित विधान न्यायिक समीक्षा से मुक्त नहीं है। अदालतों के पास यह जांचने का अधिकार है कि ऐसा विधान सक्षम अधिनियम द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों से अधिक नहीं है या संवैधानिक प्रावधानों का उल्लंघन नहीं करता है। इसलिए, कथन 2 गलत है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • न्यायपालिका, अल्ट्रा वायर्स के सिद्धांत के माध्यम से, प्रत्यायोजित विधान को रद्द कर सकती है यदि यह विधायिका द्वारा दी गई शक्तियों की सीमा से अधिक है या यदि यह मूल अधिनियम या संविधान के साथ असंगत है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information
